verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that a-Shell ships with Vim and that users can edit files and run syntax checkers inside the app via vim-lsp or ALE. Other docs reinforce that files can be edited and programs run in-app. Missing for 10: documentation of how to install or configure vim-lsp/ALE and which linters actually work, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that in-app linting works.
